title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Grand Valley State University
description: Ten current, under-21-safe late-hour food options on or near GVSU’s Allendale campus.

cards.title: Kleiner Late Night
cards.subtitle: Kleiner Commons, Allendale Campus
cards.notes: Check the Laker Food Co. hours page before heading over, then use the midnight window for a campus-based food stop.
cards.short_summary: A late-night food option in Kleiner Commons with posted service until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU lists Kleiner Late Night from 9 p.m. to midnight on its Remote Learning Day Hours page.
cards.source_title: Remote Learning Day Hours — Laker Food Co.
cards.access_notes: GVSU posts Kleiner Late Night hours as 9 p.m.–12 midnight; verify the date-specific dining schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Connection Late Night
cards.subtitle: The Connection, Allendale Campus
cards.notes: Use the university’s posted dining hours to confirm service, then stop at The Connection during its listed late-night period.
cards.short_summary: The Connection’s campus late-night service is posted through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: GVSU lists Connection Late Night from 9 p.m. to midnight on its Remote Learning Day Hours page.
cards.source_title: Remote Learning Day Hours — Laker Food Co.
cards.access_notes: GVSU posts Connection Late Night hours as 9 p.m.–12 midnight; confirm the applicable day’s dining schedule.

cards.subtitle: Kleiner Commons, Allendale Campus
cards.notes: Consult the day’s Laker Food Co. schedule, then use this convenience-store stop for a later campus purchase.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 4989 Lake Michigan Drive, Allendale
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru hours on the location page, especially if you are arriving after the dining room’s listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: This Lake Michigan Drive location posts drive-thru service as late as 3 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Allendale location page lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. most days and 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Dinner Near Me in Allendale, MI
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Wendy's
cards.subtitle: 4755 Lake Michigan Drive, Allendale
cards.notes: Confirm the location page’s daily schedule, then choose carryout, delivery, dine-in, or drive-thru based on what is still open.
cards.short_summary: A nearby Wendy’s with listed service through 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists this Allendale location open until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Jimmy John's
cards.subtitle: 4814 Lake Michigan Drive, Allendale
cards.notes: For a late delivery option, check the official delivery window and confirm your address falls within the store’s service area.
cards.short_summary: The official location page lists delivery through midnight most nights and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s lists Allendale delivery hours until midnight Sunday–Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Delivery is listed until 12 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; delivery availability depends on the address.

cards.title: Peppino's Express - Allendale
cards.subtitle: 4647 Lake Michigan Drive, Allendale
cards.notes: Use the official location page to choose carryout or delivery, and plan around the later Friday and Saturday midnight closing.
cards.short_summary: An Allendale pizza location posting carryout and delivery until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Peppino’s lists Allendale hours until midnight Friday and Saturday, with carryout and delivery available.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday, midnight Friday–Saturday, and 10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Culver's
cards.subtitle: 5128 Lake Michigan Drive NW, Allendale
cards.notes: If you are using the drive-thru, follow its later listed closing time rather than the earlier lobby and Curdside schedules.
cards.short_summary: The Allendale Culver’s lists drive-thru service until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver’s lists daily drive-thru hours of 10:30 a.m. to 11 p.m. at its Lake Michigan Drive location.
cards.source_title: Culver's of Allendale, MI — Lake Michigan Dr
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed daily until 11 p.m.; lobby closes at 10 p.m. and Curdside at 10:30 p.m.
